name: tvloop
description: Run tvloop's hardware suite against a Roku on this host's network: doctor, the contract tests, and a JUnit replay of its flows.

steps.description: What to run, in order. Default doctor, hardware, replay -- tvloop's own nightly without the spike, which sideloads ten times and is slow. A failed doctor stops the rest: nothing is worth trusting from a device that is asleep or has lost developer mode.

flows.description: Flow names or paths for replay. Default: every flow in the checkout's tests/flows.

dir.description: The tvloop checkout, built. Default FLEET_TVLOOP_DIR, then ~/tvloop.
